data.long_meaning: The name Azalika is derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Radiant One'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing prosperity, wealth, and fortune, is often referred to as the 'Radiant One'. The name Azalika carries the meaning “Radiant One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Azalika usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azalika total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
